I replied to you in our DM. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" note dated 5 Oct 2025. Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments at check-in. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's 4:00 shift got through without problems.
- **#4419**, from Moss's undated "North cheat sheet." Thea also opened this one: the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It went to second-tier support for scanner firmware testing. The note doesn't say whether it was ever fixed.

Both tickets involve Door 14. The notes don't say whether they're the same problem or two separate ones, so check that before both go in the deck.

I looked at all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. What I left out:
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 appear in Moss's notes but are tickets for Marrow accounts, not QFL.
- Moss's 14 Sep 2025 North pipeline note and 23 Mar 2026 renewal note mention QFL but give no ticket numbers.
- Marcus's note about "Quarendon Freightways" (one R) is about a different company that isn't our customer, and Moss didn't write it.
